cross_references.relationship: regulatory sibling — §10123.135 applies to CDI-regulated disability insurers; §1367 applies to DMHC-regulated Knox-Keene plans. Both apply to Blue Shield depending on which product line issued the prior authorization denial. §10123.135 and §1367(g) have effectively the same non-physician UR prohibition — the legislature harmonized them.

enforcement mechanism — §1374.30 IMR operates within the Knox-Keene framework; DMHC administers both Knox-Keene licensing and the IMR system. An adverse Knox-Keene decision (denial) triggers §1374.30 IMR rights.

adjacent — Gov. Code §815.2 public entity vicarious liability (tort); not directly applicable to Knox-Keene regulated entities (Blue Shield is private), but cross-reference because DMHC is a state agency whose enforcement decisions can be challenged under Gov. Code provisions
